_meta._note: S196 Sakana Fugu Technical Report (arxiv 2606.21228v1) + Fugu-Cyber release. NEW model Fugu-Cyber (cybersecurity orchestrator, 2026-07-21): CyberGym 86.9, CTI-REALM 72.1, comparable to GPT-5.5-Cyber/Mythos-Preview. Re-ingests Fugu & Fugu-Ultra Table 1 (Model Card) on CANONICAL benchmark ids with the OFFICIAL report values — fixes a wrong DB value (fugu-ultra SWE-Bench Pro was 54.2 = Gemini 3.1's number; official Fugu-Ultra = 73.7) and moves scores off fragmented dash-form bench ids (charxiv-reasoning->charxiv_reasoning, gpqa-diamond->gpqa_diamond, livecodebench-v6->livecodebench_v6, livecodebench-pro->livecodebench_pro, long-context-reasoning->aa_lcr). NEW benchmarks: Kana-shosoku reading-order NED (Table 3; Fugu-Ultra 0.776, Fugu 0.473 mean NED over 25 expert-annotated classical Japanese kana letters, higher better) and AutoResearch val-BPB (Table 2; Fugu-Ultra 0.9774 mean, lower better; baselines anonymized in report so not attributed). Baseline (Opus 4.8 / Gemini 3.1 / GPT-5.5) columns are provider-reported second-hand → not re-ingested (already in DB from primary sources).

benchmarks.name: Kana-shosoku Reading-Order Recovery (NED)
benchmarks.description: Sakana Fugu tech report Table 3: recovering the reading order of classical Japanese kana letters (kana-shosoku, chirashigaki scattered-writing style). 25 pages hand-annotated by a domain expert; mean normalized edit distance (NED) vs annotated order, higher is better. Model writes+improves a reading-order predictor via test-time beam search. (arxiv 2606.21228)

benchmarks.name: AutoResearch (validation BPB, lower better)
benchmarks.description: Sakana Fugu tech report Table 2: autonomous ML research (Karpathy AutoResearch) — an agent iteratively edits a small GPT training pipeline over 123 autonomous experiments (~14h/seed, single H100) to minimize validation bits-per-byte (BPB, lower better). Mean best val BPB over 3 seeds. (arxiv 2606.21228)
